methodology: Canonical identities include stripped casefolded absolute path, line, column, CS code and stripped message. Semantic changes additionally compare multisets of relative file, code and message to avoid line-shift inflation; local-name changes can still alter messages. Source operand-category counts inspect actual diagnostic lines independently in each run. Every diagnostic-bearing source file is hash/size checked against the unchanged export manifest.

interpretation.dominant_growth: CS0030 grows by 616 firstpass and 555 main. Newly retained integer-zero initializers for aggregate storage and newly resolved value-this bodies/calls expose invalid typed operands. More diagnostics do not prove improved semantics.

aggregate_storage.observation: v30 explicitly casts integer zero to List<Model>.Enumerator, stores GetEnumerator into another local, then calls MoveNext/Current/Dispose on the zero-backed local. v29 already used a separate default local instead of the GetEnumerator result. The preserved initializer is newly invalid code; the aggregate return/storage-alias defect predates v30. Native/CIL fixture validation is delegated and is not claimed by this source-only observation.

new_body.observation: v29 exports a short unresolved-call wrapper. v30 exports the real large body containing array/boxing/class-init/native-pointer limitations; these new body diagnostics must remain failures. Accepted route is documented by value-this-thunks-v30.json (287 accepted bodies).

resolved_call_regression_risk.observation: The previously unresolved adjusted value-this call now resolves to InternalDecrypt, while the caller source retains a plus-16 address adjustment and a value-to-pointer conversion. This is an invalid call/receiver sequence requiring correction. It is not certified as benign expansion merely because the old helper call was also unresolved.

interpretation.limits: No Core code changed or built in this audit. No gameplay/runtime parity, complete classification of all diagnostics, or compile-success claim. Native/actual CIL proof of the selected aggregate fixture is handled separately; source observations alone do not establish the required fix.
